title: Event recap
summary: Cut footage from an event into a highlight reel people will remember.
description: Capture the atmosphere of a workshop, gathering or launch event, stringing together the venue, key moments and attendees' reactions into a recap with a clear beginning and end.
brief: These are photos and videos from {{event}}. Cut a short recap to share with {{viewers}}. Be sure to keep: {{must-keep moments}}.

fields.label: event
fields.hint: The event's name and when it took place

fields.label: viewers
fields.hint: Who the recap is for, and where it will be shared

fields.label: must-keep moments
fields.hint: Moments you want kept; write "none" if there aren't any
fields.example: the group photo and the host's closing remarks
